facts.fact: ICT minister Tatenda Mavetera said on 2026-09-17 that the principles of the proposed e-commerce law had been taken to Cabinet, that the Attorney-General's Office was now drafting the Bill, and that the Act was expected to be concluded by the first quarter of 2027; no Bill text is stated to be published (as_of is the conference date, the Thursday before the 2026-09-18 report).
